name: Quiberon V
description: Quiberon V was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Quiberon sector. The company Gamorrean Interstellar held mining rights there, which it eventually agreed to sell to the bounty hunter Moxin Tark and his expeditor Minas Derel.
